title: LTX is DEAD in the SHIPPED release - KJNodes calls .to() on a ModelPatcher
description: All 12 shipped LTX graphs crash at the stage-1 sampler. ComfyUI f8a3fd9d made LatentUpscaleModelLoader return a ModelPatcher; KJNodes' LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride wrapper still did latent_upscale_model.to(device), and no patcher class has .to. The break landed in ComfyUI v0.29.0 and our engine pin crossed it on 2026-07-31 (v0.28.0 -> v0.29.2) - NOT the later H3 0.30.0 bump, which is what the first write of this card wrongly blamed. Both v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 ship v0.29.2 + KJNodes 7f43f2c, so every user on the current public release has had a dead LTX since 2026-08-01. Fixed by bumping the KJNodes pin to 35e5956; proven live on the bench.
acceptance: node_lock pins a KJNodes commit that carries _unwrap_upscale_model
An existing engine self-heals: the .mpi_node_commit drift check re-installs KJNodes at the new pin on boot
An LTX generation completes THROUGH THE APP on the app engine, not only on the bench
The Pod image is rebuilt or confirmed unaffected - it bakes nodes from this same lock
Decide whether this warrants a hotfix release - it is broken in the CURRENT public release, not just on master

attention.reason: LOCAL half CONFIRMED by the user 2026-08-08: LTX image-to-video ops all tested and passed on this machine (same for WAN and both H3 models). What is left is exactly one thing and it is not a human judgement - the REMOTE half, i.e. the Pod image running the 0.30.0 engine, which the MPI-467 smoke matrix proves. That run has been attempted 3x and has never reached the GPU stage; ~97 GB of the fill sits on volume aghcuvg7nl. Close this card on smoke-evidence.json, not on another local check.
